name: 1 Pair Free Size Heel Anti Crack Set For Men & Women For Anti Chapped,Dry,Rough, Homythick, Crust
description:
1 Pair Free Size Heel Anti Crack Set For Men & Women For Anti Chapped,Dry,Rough, Homythick, Crust 

Eliminate dry 
Removal of calluses 
Softens the horniness 
Relieve heel pain 
Washable and reusable: hand wash in water with detergent powder and dry in a shade avoiding direct exposure to sunlight 
Orthopedic silicone heel protectors: protects heel bone from extreme pressure, fatigue, and strain, prevents thickening of heel skin, keeps heel safe from blisters, chipped skin, corn, and cracked feet. 
Relief pain prevents joints and foot pain caused by poorly padded footwear, daily weight pressure, walking and standing, ultimate heel pain, and heel swelling relief. 
Unisize: one size fits for, provides extra cushioning, shock absorption, anti-slip, breathable, ultimate heel pain relief slip-on pads, for heel pain, spurs, heel swelling. 
WASHABLE AND REUSABLE: Hand wash in water with detergent powder and dry in a shade avoiding direct exposure to sunlight. 
DIRECTION FOR USAGE: If you are confused about how to wear it, then please refer to the images that we have uploaded for this product. And please do not wear continuously & do not walk too much with wearing the product on your heel because it is soft delicate & may not be able to withstand outdoor walking.
